text: Upgrade cozo from 0.7 to 0.8+ and remove fd-lock workaround in connect_db once upstream SQLITE_BUSY unwrap panic is fixed (U015-FLK1). DEFERRED: cozo 0.8 does not yet exist on crates.io (latest stable: 0.7.6 as of 2026-05-01). Monitor upstream. See deliberation: docs/decisions/2026-05-01-cozodb-concurrency-hardening-deliberation.md

Pre-existing daemon subprocess spawn timeout on Windows — smoke_full_tool_chain_over_ipc and daemon_rehydrates_graph_and_vector_state_after_db_directory_is_deleted fail because CozoDB 0.7.6 new_cozo_sqlite panics at sqlite.rs:49 conn.prepare().unwrap() when opened in a subprocess context on Windows. Daemon never reports Ready. Root cause is upstream cozo 0.7.6 unwrap() on prepare(); investigate whether upgrading cozo or using WAL mode pragma mitigates the subprocess open panic. Source: docs/closure/2026-05-03-038-F-daemon-reliability-phase2-closure.md

Upgrade CozoDB to >= 0.8 and remove Windows+Linux cfg_attr ignore gates from subprocess tests (smoke_test.rs, graph_vector_rehydration_test.rs). Once CozoDB handles SQLITE_BUSY gracefully in subprocess contexts, the cfg_attr(any(target_os = "windows", target_os = "linux"), ignore) annotations can be removed to restore full Windows and Linux test coverage. Note: rehydration test also needs design fix — wait-for-auto-index loop means map_code assertion passes from fresh re-index rather than JSONL rehydration; redesign to verify rehydrated-only state before auto-index completes. Source: docs/closure/2026-05-04-039-F-daemon-reliability-phase3-closure.md
